title: Integer coefficients for a strict representation
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index type and $\alpha$ a finite set, and let $f$ assign a sign to each element of $\alpha$. Given real-valued features on $\iota\times\alpha$ and real coefficients that represent $f$ strictly—meaning the sign of $f(x)$ times the resulting feature sum is positive for every $x$—there are integer coefficients that still represent $f$ strictly.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued feature is given for each index and element
Real coefficients give a strict representation at every element
